before: setHyperlinkTarget had no revision attribution, so a retarget could not be proposed.
after: setHyperlinkTarget accepts optional revision attribution. The old link keeps its target with struck runs and a retargeted copy follows with the same runs as a tracked insertion. Resolution hoists markers out of a link it empties of runs.
reason: The untracked retarget runs outside journal capture only to compute the new link attributes; peers receive the paragraph splice and the native tracked deletion. No relationship is rewritten and no shared journal, schema, or transport field changes.
